# using-blendops (reference summary)

## Purpose
Entry point for BlendOps: pick the next stage from current artifacts and evidence, and keep every user-facing reply in plain language with honest truth states.

## Metadata & truth boundary
- **Canonical skill:** `skills/using-blendops/SKILL.md`
- **Contract:** `skills/using-blendops/contract.json` (`v2.0.0`)
- **Category / role:** `routing-and-governance` / `entry-router-stage-router-and-plain-language-output`
- **Capability tier:** `L0`
- **Routing precedence:** group `entry-and-stage-routing`, rank `3` | activationGate: `goalClarity="clear"`, `recipeSelected=true`, `preflightPassed=true`, `hasStageOrArtifactInventory=true`
- **Truth-state policy:** Runtime status defaults to `Not Run`; Artifact status defaults to `Not Produced`; mutation rule is `downgrade_only` (never upgrade without verified evidence).

## When to use
- The user is new to BlendOps or unsure which step comes next.
- Work is resuming and the next stage depends on which artifacts and evidence already exist.
- Any reply to the user needs to explain status, truth states, or Blender terms in plain language.

## Trigger cues
- "where are we in the workflow"
- "what's next"
- "resume from here"
- "next skill"
- "What should I do next?"
- "Which BlendOps skill should I use?"
- "Is this ready?"
- "Can I run the runtime eval?"
- "How do I package/install BlendOps?"
- "What is blocked?"
- "write final user summary"
- "explain this for non-Blender user"
- "make this stakeholder-friendly"

## When not to use
- Goal is clear but no recipe or pack has been chosen yet → delegate to `scoping-3d-briefs` (`references/skills/scoping-3d-briefs.md`; Selects the fitting recipe/pack at precedence Rank 2)
- Pack is selected and brief exists, but pack preflight has not completed yet → delegate to `defining-done-and-gates` (`references/skills/defining-done-and-gates.md`; Executes preflight readiness verification at precedence Rank 3 before stage routing)
- Active MCP runtime bridge conflict on port 9876 → delegate to `setting-up-blender-runtime` (`references/skills/setting-up-blender-runtime.md`; Resolves port and dual add-on conflicts before advancing)
- The goal is clear and the user wants to select the right recipe or pack → delegate to `scoping-3d-briefs` (`references/skills/scoping-3d-briefs.md`; Scores candidate recipes/packs and detects multi-deliverable scope)
- A recipe or pack is already selected and needs preflight readiness verification → delegate to `defining-done-and-gates` (`references/skills/defining-done-and-gates.md`; Evaluates the preflight matrix across brief completeness, runtime posture, and asset readiness)
- The user explicitly asks to turn an idea into a structured 3D brief → delegate to `scoping-3d-briefs` (`references/skills/scoping-3d-briefs.md`; Locks the canonical 8-slot 3D brief before scene planning)
- The user asks to plan a product-hero scene directly → delegate to `planning-product-scenes` (`references/skills/planning-product-scenes.md`; Handles domain-specific scene planning once brief and recipe are known)
- The user asks for render or export artifact verification → delegate to `verifying-before-handoff` (`references/skills/verifying-before-handoff.md`; Classifies artifact truth states from on-disk paths and validation notes)
- The user asks for Blender MCP runtime preflight verification → delegate to `setting-up-blender-runtime` (`references/skills/setting-up-blender-runtime.md`; Verifies Path 1 or Path 2 runtime readiness without claiming execution)
- to hide blockers, drop caveats for readability, or overclaim runtime or artifact success → delegate to `verifying-before-handoff` (`references/skills/verifying-before-handoff.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to verifying-before-handoff)
- to upgrade Runtime or Artifact truth states → delegate to `verifying-before-handoff` (`references/skills/verifying-before-handoff.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to verifying-before-handoff)
- to classify raw artifact evidence → delegate to `verifying-before-handoff` (`references/skills/verifying-before-handoff.md`; use verifying-before-handoff)
- to generate technical pass/warn/fail checks → delegate to `verifying-before-handoff` (`references/skills/verifying-before-handoff.md`; use verifying-before-handoff or domain quality checkers)
- to assemble technical GLB/web compatibility summaries → delegate to `handing-off-glb-to-web` (`references/skills/handing-off-glb-to-web.md`; use handing-off-glb-to-web)
- to gate handoff readiness → delegate to `verifying-before-handoff` (`references/skills/verifying-before-handoff.md`; use verifying-before-handoff)

## Inputs & output/evidence contract
### Required inputs
- `current_artifact_inventory` (`artifact_inventory`): Determines current milestone stage and downgrade-only truth labels
- `active_intent` (`string`): Prevents routing to the wrong domain branch

### Optional inputs
- `target_pack_or_recipe` (`string`): Narrows milestone track
- `user_request` (`string`): Ambiguous, mixed, or entry-level user question about BlendOps capabilities or next action
- `current_status_context` (`object`): Optional context about known files, docs, or blockers
- `verified_workflow_and_evidence_state` (`object`): Final pre-handoff verification gate status, runtime truth state, and artifact truth state
- `deliverable_summary_inputs` (`object`): Technical outputs from scene planners, quality checkers, or handoff packagers to translate
- `stakeholder_audience_profile` (`string`): Target reader role (product manager, web developer, creative director, end user)

### Primary outputs
- `current_stage_name`
- `single_immediate_next_skill`
- `preconditions_checklist`
- `recommended_next_action`
- `target_skill_or_doc`
- `why_this_is_safe`
- `plain_language_stakeholder_response`
- `explicit_runtime_and_artifact_status_block`
- `jargon_free_next_steps`

## Quick-start procedure
1. Confirm the user's goal and the current runtime and artifact state.
2. Pick the branch in the decision tree below.
3. Load only that branch's reference file and follow it.
4. Reply with the user-facing template, keeping truth states honest.

## Handoff notes
- **[upstream_reference]** Pack entry preflight gate → `defining-done-and-gates` (`references/skills/defining-done-and-gates.md`) — `when.all: [preflight.passed equals false]`
- **[conditional]** Runtime readiness check → `setting-up-blender-runtime` (`references/skills/setting-up-blender-runtime.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.status equals "Not Run"; stage.requiresRuntime equals true]`
- **[fallback]** Active MCP bridge conflict on port 9876 → `setting-up-blender-runtime` (`references/skills/setting-up-blender-runtime.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.conflictDetected equals true]`
- **[boundary_delegation]** Mid-workflow scope expansion or unapproved deliverable addition → `defining-done-and-gates` (`references/skills/defining-done-and-gates.md`) — `when.all: [scope.driftDetected equals true]`
- **[progression]** Evidence updates for render or export outputs → `verifying-before-handoff` (`references/skills/verifying-before-handoff.md`) — `when.all: [stage.current equals "post_execution_audit"]`
- **[fallback]** Failed gate / blocked mode exit / final gate → `verifying-before-handoff` (`references/skills/verifying-before-handoff.md`) — `when.any: [gate.status equals "failed"; runtime.mode equals "blocked"; stage.current equals "final_verification"]`
- **[progression]** Recipe or pack selection when goal becomes clear → `scoping-3d-briefs` (`references/skills/scoping-3d-briefs.md`) — `when.all: [goal.clarity equals "clear"; recipe.selected equals false]`
- **[conditional]** Pack preflight readiness check when recipe is already chosen → `defining-done-and-gates` (`references/skills/defining-done-and-gates.md`) — `when.all: [recipe.selected equals true; preflight.passed equals false]`
- **[progression]** Initial 3D brief creation → `scoping-3d-briefs` (`references/skills/scoping-3d-briefs.md`) — `when.all: [brief.locked equals false]`
- **[conditional]** Runtime path selection → `setting-up-blender-runtime` (`references/skills/setting-up-blender-runtime.md`) — `when.all: [request.topic equals "runtime_selection"]`
- **[conditional]** Official runtime setup → `setting-up-blender-runtime` (`references/skills/setting-up-blender-runtime.md`) — `when.all: [request.topic equals "runtime_setup"]`
- **[conditional]** Runtime readiness preflight → `setting-up-blender-runtime` (`references/skills/setting-up-blender-runtime.md`) — `when.all: [request.topic equals "runtime_readiness"]`
- **[alternative]** Scene planning → `planning-product-scenes` (`references/skills/planning-product-scenes.md`) — `when.all: [brief.locked equals true; recipe.id equals "product-hero-v0"]`
- **[conditional]** Render/export evidence → `verifying-before-handoff` (`references/skills/verifying-before-handoff.md`) — `when.all: [request.topic equals "artifact_evidence"]`
- **[fallback]** Failed workflow gate / pre-handoff check → `verifying-before-handoff` (`references/skills/verifying-before-handoff.md`) — `when.all: [gate.status equals "failed"]`
- **[conditional]** GLB handoff → `handing-off-glb-to-web` (`references/skills/handing-off-glb-to-web.md`) — `when.all: [request.topic equals "glb_handoff"]`
- **[fallback]** Upstream quality pass/warn/fail validation (verifying-before-handoff) → `verifying-before-handoff` (`references/skills/verifying-before-handoff.md`) — `when.all: [quality.domain equals "holistic"; stage.current equals "quality_validation"]`
- **[fallback]** Upstream quality pass/warn/fail validation (planning-camera-and-framing) → `planning-camera-and-framing` (`references/skills/planning-camera-and-framing.md`) — `when.all: [quality.domain equals "composition"; quality.verdict equals "not_run"]`
- **[fallback]** Upstream quality pass/warn/fail validation (planning-lighting-and-materials) → `planning-lighting-and-materials` (`references/skills/planning-lighting-and-materials.md`) — `when.all: [quality.domain equals "lighting"; quality.verdict equals "not_run"]`
- **[fallback]** Upstream quality pass/warn/fail validation (planning-lighting-and-materials) → `planning-lighting-and-materials` (`references/skills/planning-lighting-and-materials.md`) — `when.all: [quality.domain equals "material"; quality.verdict equals "not_run"]`
- **[fallback]** Upstream quality pass/warn/fail validation (budgeting-glb-for-web) → `budgeting-glb-for-web` (`references/skills/budgeting-glb-for-web.md`) — `when.all: [quality.domain equals "polycount"; budget.verdict equals "Not Run"]`
- **[upstream_reference]** Upstream GLB/web handoff summary → `handing-off-glb-to-web` (`references/skills/handing-off-glb-to-web.md`) — `when.all: [artifact.type equals "glb"; handoff.consumerStack equals "web_glb"]`
- **[upstream_reference]** Upstream handoff gate check → `verifying-before-handoff` (`references/skills/verifying-before-handoff.md`) — `when.all: [stage.current equals "final_verification"]`
- **[upstream_reference]** Runtime readiness check when runtime is unverified → `setting-up-blender-runtime` (`references/skills/setting-up-blender-runtime.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.path not_equals "unselected"; runtime.verifiedReady equals false]`

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- **Runtime boundary:** BlendOps runtime guidance uses **2 MCP execution paths plus a CLI fallback appendix** (replaces older 3-stack and 4-route drafts — see `docs/runtime-stack-strategy.md` for the corrected attribution history):
- Does not install Blender, configure an MCP bridge, or own a runtime; it points to upstream paths only.
- Does not claim render, export, preview, or GLB results without evidence.
- Does not hand the user Python as the final interface.
